subject: CS361
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 high-quality videos, 5 for English and 5 for Arabic, covering all specified topics. Selections prioritize high-relevance, peer-validated content from established educational channels like Kevin Powell, w3schools, Elzero Web School, and Abdelrahman Gamal. All candidates passed strict quality gates for views, duration, and language.

coverage.note: Most other candidates were irrelevant (math topics).
Only one candidate passed the view count gate.

videos.title: HTML & CSS for Beginners Part 5: Links
videos.filter_reason: Excellent explanation from a highly respected educator, clearly distinguishing between relative and absolute paths with high view count confirming peer validation.

videos.title: HTML - Introduction - W3Schools.com
videos.filter_reason: A concise, authoritative, and massively popular video from W3Schools that perfectly illustrates the fundamental structure of an HTML5 document for beginners.

videos.title: HTML Tags, Attributes and Elements
videos.filter_reason: This video directly addresses the common confusion between tags, elements, and attributes, making it highly relevant and effective for students.

videos.title: 12: How to Create Links in HTML | Basics of CSS| Learn HTML and CSS | Full Course For Beginners
videos.filter_reason: A comprehensive and very popular tutorial that covers how to create links in HTML, making it an ideal choice for beginners.

videos.title: HTML validation | Computer programming | Khan Academy
videos.filter_reason: From Khan Academy, this is a short, clear, and authoritative introduction to using the W3C validator, perfect for teaching the concept quickly.

videos.title: دورة تعلم html كاملة - الدرس 35 | شرح File Paths - طريقة تحديد مسار ملفات

videos.title: 1- HTML5 Structure|| مقدمة وهيكلة الصفحة
videos.filter_reason: This video's title is 'HTML5 Structure' and it provides a great, highly-viewed explanation of the basic page structure for Arabic-speaking students.

videos.title: #4 كورس html كامل بالعربي | html components
videos.filter_reason: From a top-tier channel, this video explains 'HTML components', holistically covering the relationship between tags, elements, and attributes with massive viewership.

videos.title: Learn HTML In Arabic 2021 - #12 - Links - Anchor Tag
videos.filter_reason: This is the highest-viewed and most relevant video on the topic in Arabic, from the leading Elzero Web School channel, perfectly explaining anchor tags.
